comments.author: Juicebox
comments.body:
CPC Trader Tips

This item isnt worthless actually its the best just have to think logically. You make the most money nanbanning during lawless with that said..

1.The 24 hr flag last 24 hours but think about how often do you actually use the complete protection? Leaving/Entering/exchanging in sakai 5 mins going through lawless sea 5 to 10 mins? Even if you make multiple runs the most you "actually" need complete protection is an hour or 2 tops the rest of the time is wasted basically you're paying for nothing .

2. I bet you're thinking but what about the rest of my journey from nanbanning I need protection.. Nope the rest of the trip is through seas that aren't lawless and can simply trib through. So again complete protection is not needed.

3. So basically a 24hr flag is 100mil so any nabanning you do for a day subtract 100mil aka 1 full nanban per day is spent buying protection OUCH.. I don't like subtracting profit for no reason especially when I'm not actively using the complete protection for the full 24hours.

4.obtained in game for free

With this item I can use as I see fit travelling in actual lawless water and I think the price of this should be roughly 5 to 10 mil tops because skimming 10 mil off my nanbans is better than skimming 100mil off right? If you use this in conjunction with tribs its the most cost effective way to nanban or adv in lawless water. Time is Money...So why pay for time you're not actually using.
